title: Part Six: Curtis Yarvin: the Program and the Hard Posts

sections.brief: Formalism (23 Apr 2007), the Cathedral (his and Land's definitions), neocameralism, the CEO-monarch and the secret board, Patchwork and exit/voice, RAGE (2012, Pein's record of the talk; 'Random Acts' version false), the route from 2009 persuasion to the 2025 interviews and the reported 2022 'ninjas'; vocabulary softened, design unchanged; RAGE vs 2025 cuts as rhyme, not provenance. Figures: flow, time

Five posts each dated, quoted short, with context, his later account and critics: 'Why I am not a white nationalist' (22 Nov 2007), Patchwork 1 surplus residents ('Fris Corp', 13 Nov 2008), Patchwork 2 biodiesel/VR (20 Nov 2008), 'Why Carlyle Matters' (July 2009; own voice; preceding paragraph not examined; 'races better suited' false quotation), Breivik (23 July 2011; not an endorsement). Figures: compare, time

Red-flag rubric applied to ten of Yarvin's own public claims: white nationalism, 'just kidding', slavery, non-violence, dictator-to-weak-democracy, influence, Thiel 'coaching', Bannon, Urbit return, Breivik; 0 RED, 0 ORANGE, 3 YELLOW, 6 GREY, 1 no flag; why no RED/ORANGE; worst-case reading tested. Figures: compare, stats
